title: Slater's Monmouthshire Directory 1858–59
narrative:
Despatch.—To London and all parts every evening at nine.—To the NORTH OF ENGLAND, IRELAND and SCOTLAND every afternoon at forty five minutes past five.—To CARMARTHEN AND SOUTH WALES every morning at thirty-five minutes past eight.—To ABERGAVENNY, TREDGAR, USK, and local post same time.
